name: 3D Noise Generation with Box Filtering
definition: Generates a 3D tiling noise volume and applies a 3×3×3 box blur to hide trilinear interpolation grid artifacts, as advised for procedural volume rendering.
summary: 3D Noise Generation with Box Filtering creates seamless tiling noise volumes by averaging 3x3x3 neighborhoods with modulo wrapping to hide trilinear interpolation artifacts.
